200.summary: Polish ambassador to UN becomes third envoy to resign amid crisis over constitutional court Nov 2, 2026 | Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work!
200.body: Polish ambassador to UN becomes third envoy to resign amid crisis over constitutional court Nov 2, 2026 | Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! Poland’s ambassador to the United Nations, Krzysztof Szczerski, has resigned from his position, becoming the third Polish ambassador to do so since a government-backed move by a group of judges to take control of the Constitutional Tribunal (TK) in Warsaw. There is chaos at Poland's constitutional court tonight as a group of government-backed judges moved to take control from the opposition-aligned chief justice. However, the court has been in crisis since 2015 , when Duda and the then-PiS government – which came to power that year – unlawfully rejected three judges appointed by the former parliament and replaced them with three of their own.

In particular, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) runs the Energy Security Support Facility, which partially covers the risk of partner banks on loans for decentralized generation, energy storage, and energy efficiency.
400.body: What will it take for energy storage projects in Ukraine to work at scale? In particular, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) runs the Energy Security Support Facility, which partially covers the risk of partner banks on loans for decentralized generation, energy storage, and energy efficiency. An industrial energy storage system also helps balance the grid and makes the power supply more reliable. The economics need to be calculated in full: the cost of charging energy, losses during storage and discharge, the consumption of the cooling system, how fast the batteries degrade, and the cost of servicing, insurance, financing, and potential component replacements.

600.title: Polish volleyball league opposed Italian clubs: We want an urgent change to the calendar!
600.summary: While Italian clubs are opposing the changes to the world calendar proposed by the International Volleyball Federation (FIVB), the Polish Professional Volleyball League (PLS) has officially insisted on the fastest possible reform of the current system.
600.body: While Italian clubs are opposing the changes to the world calendar proposed by the International Volleyball Federation (FIVB), the Polish Professional Volleyball League (PLS) has officially insisted on the fastest possible reform of the current system. Poland: The current calendar hinders the development of volleyball According to the Polish league, dividing the year into two independent periods – club and national – creates serious problems for the organization of championships and the health of athletes. "The Polish Professional Volleyball League recommends taking urgent action and ending the stagnation that has lasted for years," states the concluding part of the official statement. One problem, two opposing positions While Gino Sirci and the Italian clubs supporting him warn of the risks of interrupting national championships in winter, the Polish side believes that the current division between club and national season is already causing serious damage.

600.title: Empowerment beneficiary Latvia earns EEVZA U20 men’s silver
600.summary: EEVZA U20 Men’s Volleyball Championship in Yerevan, Armenia FIVB Volleyball Empowerment funded Latvia claimed silver at last week’s EEVZA U20 Men’s Volleyball Championship in Yerevan, Armenia. The Volleyball Federation of Latvia has so far been allocated a total of USD 504,000 in FIVB Volleyball Empowerment coach support for their national volleyball teams, in addition to USD 210,500 in volleyball equipment.
600.body: EEVZA U20 Men’s Volleyball Championship in Yerevan, Armenia FIVB Volleyball Empowerment funded Latvia claimed silver at last week’s EEVZA U20 Men’s Volleyball Championship in Yerevan, Armenia. The Volleyball Federation of Latvia has so far been allocated a total of USD 504,000 in FIVB Volleyball Empowerment coach support for their national volleyball teams, in addition to USD 210,500 in volleyball equipment. At the EEVZA U20 Men’s Volleyball Championship, the Latvian team (pictured in the main photo; source: Volleyball Federation of Armenia) topped the Pool B standings with wins over Ukraine (3-2) and hosts Armenia (3-1), before conceding to Estonia in a 3-1 (25-22, 25-22, 28-30, 25-13) final showdown on Saturday. The tournament’s Dream team featured setter Jakub Przybylkowicz (Poland), opposite Adam Potempa (Poland), outside hitters Carl Kreek (Estonia) and Tomass Silavs (Latvia), middle blockers Holger Purga (Estonia) and Cezary Slusarz (Poland), and libero Olivers Pope (Latvia).
